h1:
Where to Stay in Koh Chang?
12 Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Koh Chang hotels across every budget — luxury beachfront resorts and boutique pool villas, down to value bungalows and a beachfront guesthouse. Covering the main beaches: White Sand, Klong Prao, Kai Bae, Lonely Beach, Bang Bao, and Klong Son. Starting from around ฿400–12,000/night.
heroStats: 🏖️ 6 main beaches (White Sand·Klong Prao·Kai Bae·Lonely Beach·Bang Bao·Klong Son)
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right beach on Koh Chang matter?
introHtml: Koh Chang is a big, long island, and its beaches are spread out and feel quite different from one another — White Sand Beach (Haad Sai Khao) is the liveliest, with the most restaurants and bars · Klong Prao is a long, quieter beach good for relaxing and families · Kai Bae has a sandy beach and little-island views that are lovely at sunset · Lonely Beach / Bailan is the chilled-out quiet zone in the south · Bang Bao is a fishing-village pier at the tip of the island, the jumping-off point for nearby islands · and Klong Son up north near the ferry pier is quiet and private. Many travellers book without checking which beach, then spend the whole trip driving up and down the hilly coast road back and forth. This guide brings together 12 Koh Chang hotels we've reviewed across every tier — from luxury beachfront resorts down to value seafront guesthouses. Every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Chang has no city-style public transport — the main ways to get around are renting a scooter or car, or the shared songthaew trucks that run the west-coast road. Getting to the island means a 30–45 minute car ferry from Laem Ngop pier in Trat province (cars can drive on board). The main beaches in this guide, north to south: Klong Son — near the pier, quiet and private (Aiyapura) · White Sand Beach — the liveliest, lots of restaurants and bars (KC Grande, Independent Bo's) · Klong Prao — long, quiet beach, good for families (Emerald Cove, Aana, Klong Prao Resort) · Kai Bae — sandy beach with island views, lovely at sunset (Sylvan, Kaibae Beach Resort) · Lonely Beach / Bailan — chilled-out quiet zone in the south (Nest Sense, Warapura) · Bang Bao — fishing-village pier at the tip, boat departures (Bang Bao Cliff View, Indie Beach).

entries.name: The Aiyapura Koh Chang
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Klong Son bay · near the pier · Koh Chang
entries.addr: 139 Moo 4, Klong Son, Klong Son bay, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.4 — Aiyapura is a luxury resort spread across a 40-rai hillside above Klong Son bay in the north, near the ferry pier. Reviews most often mention the spacious, leafy grounds, the quiet private beach, and the choice of rooms from main-building rooms up to garden villas and sea-view villas. Being close to the pier makes it easy to reach, ideal if you want a quiet stay from your very first night on the island.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Go for a Villa with Sea View if the budget allows — reviews often praise the views over Klong Son bay from the hillside. The resort is large, so ask about the internal shuttle.
pros: Highest score in the guide, 9.4, from real reviews
Spacious 40-rai leafy grounds, quiet private beach (per reviews)
Closest to the ferry pier of any pick here
Range of rooms and villas to suit different budgets
cons: On the Klong Son side, away from lively White Sand Beach — you'll drive
Large hillside resort; walking can tire you, some spots need the shuttle

entries.name: The Emerald Cove Koh Chang
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Klong Prao Beach · beachfront · Koh Chang
tags: 🛎️ Reopened in the IHG Vignette group
entries.addr: 88/8 Moo 4, Klong Prao Beach, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Emerald Cove is a beachfront resort on Klong Prao that reopened in the IHG Vignette Collection, scoring 9.3 from 242 reviews. Reviews most often mention the 50-metre beachfront pool and the west-facing sea-view rooms where you can watch the sunset. It sits on Klong Prao, a longer and quieter beach than White Sand, and suits travellers who want a beachfront stay to international-chain standards. Rooms range from Deluxe up to Pool Villa.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Bump up to a Deluxe Ocean Facing for the west-facing sea view — reviews mention sunsets from the balcony often. Check the current name when booking (Dinso Resort & Villas).
pros: On Klong Prao Beach, 50-metre beachfront pool (per reviews)
International-chain standards in the IHG Vignette group
West-facing sea-view rooms for sunset watching
High score 9.3 from a large number of reviews (242)
cons: Sea-view rooms cost notably more than garden/hill-view rooms
Rebranded/renamed — confirm the current name matches when booking

entries.name: Sylvan Koh Chang
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kai Bae · hillside down to a private beach · Koh Chang
entries.addr: 79 Moo 4, Kai Bae Beach, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Sylvan is a luxury resort on a hillside that tumbles down to a private beach at Kai Bae, scoring 9.1 from 321 reviews. Reviews most often mention the design that blends into the forest, the infinity pool with views of the little islands off Kai Bae, and the funicular cable car that carries you between the hillside rooms and the beach. The atmosphere is private and calm, ideal for couples and anyone wanting a luxurious nature retreat.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Choose a Deluxe Clifftop for the better hillside sea view — but if you'd rather not use the cable car often, pick a Deluxe Beachfront closer to the sand.
pros: Private beach and infinity pool with island views at Kai Bae (per reviews)
Hillside-in-the-forest design, private and leafy
Cable car makes getting up and down easy and fun
High score 9.1 from a large number of reviews (321)
cons: Hillside layout means cable car / stairs — not ideal if walking is hard
At the end of Kai Bae, so you'll drive to reach restaurants

entries.name: KC Grande Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 White Sand Beach · beachfront · Koh Chang
entries.addr: 1/1 Moo 4, White Sand Beach (Haad Sai Khao), Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: KC Grande is a beachfront resort on White Sand Beach with a large review base of 503, scoring 8.9. Reviews most often mention the 40-metre rooftop infinity pool and the fact there are four pools across the resort. It sits on White Sand Beach, the island's liveliest, so you can walk to restaurants and bars. It suits travellers who want to be on the beach and near the action, with the full facilities of a big resort.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Seaside zone is right on the beach, while the Hillside zone is across the road with hill views. For direct beach access pick a Seaside room, and head up to the rooftop pool at sunset.
pros: 40m rooftop infinity pool and four pools in total (per reviews)
On White Sand Beach, walk to restaurants and bars
Largest review base among the 4-star picks (503)
Full facilities of a big resort
cons: White Sand Beach is lively, not as quiet as Klong Prao or Klong Son
Hillside-zone rooms are across the road from the beach — check the zone

entries.name: Nest Sense Resort
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.0 · 470 reviews · Bailan bay / Lonely Beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bailan bay · end of Lonely Beach · Koh Chang
entries.addr: 188 Moo 1, Bailan bay, Koh Chang (end of Lonely Beach)
entries.storyHtml: Nest Sense is a small 18-room boutique resort on a clifftop at Bailan bay, the end of Lonely Beach, scoring 9.0 from 470 reviews. Reviews most often mention the clifftop infinity pool with open sea views where you can watch a lovely sunset. Rooms range from accessible Deluxe rooms up to sea-view pool villas with private pools. It's in the quiet southern zone with a chilled vibe, ideal for couples and anyone escaping the crowds, at a price below the luxury resorts.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, the Sea View Pool Villa with its private pool and sea view is worth it. Reviews mention the sunset spot by the pool often — grab a seat before dusk.
pros: Clifftop infinity pool with sea views and lovely sunsets (per reviews)
Small 18-room boutique, quiet and private
Both accessible rooms and sea-view pool villas
High score 9.0 from a large number of reviews (470)
cons: At the end of Lonely Beach / Bailan, far from other main beaches — you'll drive
It's a clifftop; the swim spot out front isn't a sandy beach

entries.name: Klong Prao Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Klong Prao Beach · beachfront · Koh Chang
entries.addr: Moo 4, Klong Prao Beach, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Klong Prao Resort is a value beachfront resort on Klong Prao with a large review base of 559, scoring 8.6. Reviews most often mention the spacious low-rise garden-bungalow layout, the big beachfront pool, and the more-than-3km sandy beach. From just ฿1,600 you get a beachfront spot in a spacious resort — ideal for families and mid-budget travellers who want to be on Klong Prao, which is quieter than White Sand.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Bump up to a Superior or Deluxe for a better-condition room, some closer to the pool or beach. Travelling as a family, ask for a spacious, leafy garden bungalow.
pros: On Klong Prao, a sandy beach over 3km long (per reviews)
Spacious low-rise garden bungalows, good for families
Large beachfront pool · starts from ฿1,600
Large review base (559), consistent 8.6 score
cons: Some Standard bungalows are older — pick Superior/Deluxe for condition
Large grounds mean some long walks, some spots far from the beach/pool

entries.name: Aana Resort & Spa

rooms.type: Garden View Villa with Plunge Pool
River View Villa with Plunge Pool

entries.addr: 19 Moo 2, Klong Prao, Klong Prao estuary, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Aana is a boutique river resort at the Klong Prao estuary, scoring 8.6 from 143 reviews. Reviews most often mention the villas with private plunge pools, the calm, leafy river-and-mountain views, and the free kayaking on the river. There's a private beach reached by boat, giving it a different feel from a typical beachfront resort. It suits couples and nature lovers who want a quiet riverside stay surrounded by greenery.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, the River View Villa with Plunge Pool gives you river views and a private pool. Try the morning kayak on the river that reviews mention often.
pros: Villas with private plunge pools and river views (per reviews)
Quiet riverside setting surrounded by nature
Free river kayaking · private beach reached by boat
Private boutique feel, good for couples and nature lovers
cons: Not directly on a beach — you take a boat to the private beach
Cheaper main-building rooms have no private pool — pick a villa for that

entries.name: Warapura Resort
entries.storyHtml: Warapura is a boutique seafront resort at Lonely Beach with the most reviews in this guide — over 870, scoring 8.4. Reviews most often mention the wooden deck that juts out over the sea for sunset watching and the 20 chic wooden bungalows with their laid-back vibe. It's a 5–10 minute walk to Lonely Beach. This is the chilled southern zone that relaxed travellers love, and from ฿1,700 it's good value for the vibe and seafront location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, the Seaside Villa with its direct sea view is worth it. Head to the seafront deck in the evening for the sunset that reviews mention often.
pros: Most reviews in the guide, 870, scoring 8.4
Seafront sunset deck and laid-back vibe (per reviews)
Chic wooden bungalows, 5–10 min walk to Lonely Beach
From ฿1,700, good value for a seafront location
cons: Not on a sandy beach — the front is a seafront deck
Nice Cottage rooms are compact — pick a villa for more space

entries.name: Indie Beach Bungalows
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.8 · 110 reviews · Hat Sai Noi, Bang Bao
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Hat Sai Noi · Bang Bao / Klong Kloi · Koh Chang
entries.addr: 32/3 Hat Sai Noi, Moo 1, Bang Bao, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Indie Beach is a set of around 9 bohemian beachfront bungalows on Hat Sai Noi, in the Bang Bao / Klong Kloi zone, scoring 8.8 from 110 reviews — high for a 2-star. Reviews most often mention the chilled, quiet beachfront vibe, the beach cafe and yoga classes. The bungalows are air-conditioned with hot-water bathrooms, but there's no pool. It suits relaxed travellers and couples who want a quiet, private-feeling beach at an accessible price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, the Deluxe Bungalow with Sea View is closest to the beach with the best view. There's no pool here, so if a pool matters, choose elsewhere.
pros: Chilled bohemian beachfront vibe (per reviews)
Beach cafe and yoga classes, good for relaxing
Score 8.8, high for a 2-star, at an accessible price
Air-conditioned bungalows, hot water, clean and simple
cons: No swimming pool · only around 9 bungalows, books up fast
Hat Sai Noi is in the Bang Bao zone at the tip, far from the main beaches

entries.name: Kaibae Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kai Bae Beach · beachfront · Koh Chang
tags: 🏖️ Walk straight from your room to the sand
entries.addr: 10/3 Moo 4, Kai Bae Beach, Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Kaibae Beach Resort is a roughly 59-room beachfront resort in the middle of Kai Bae Beach, scoring 8.4 from 175 reviews. Reviews most often mention being able to walk straight from your room onto the sand, the pool and kids' pool, and the views of the little islands off Kai Bae that are lovely at sunset. From just ฿1,500 you're beachfront in the heart of Kai Bae, within walking distance of restaurants — ideal for families and mid-budget travellers who want a value beachfront stay.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, a Beachfront Bungalow steps straight onto the sand with the best view. Travelling as a family, the Family Room sleeps 3–4.
pros: Walk straight from your room onto Kai Bae beach (per reviews)
Pool and kids' pool, good for families
Central Kai Bae, walk to restaurants · from ฿1,500
Lovely island views off the beach at sunset
cons: Some Superior building rooms are older — pick Deluxe/Bungalow
A mid-size resort; fewer facilities than the luxury picks

entries.name: Independent Bo's
entries.revCount: Agoda 7.6 · 44 reviews · end of White Sand Beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 End of White Sand Beach · on the rocks · Koh Chang
entries.addr: Northern end of White Sand Beach (Haad Sai Khao), Koh Chang
entries.storyHtml: Independent Bo's is the cheapest stay in this guide, from just ฿400, on the rocks at the end of White Sand Beach, scoring 7.6. Reviews most often mention the old-school backpacker vibe, the simple fan rooms on stilts above the rocks, and the seaside bar that's a relaxed spot to take in the view. It's the most basic option here — the cheapest rooms have no air-con and some share a bathroom. It suits budget backpackers who care more about vibe and price than comfort.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a private bathroom and a bit more of a view, pick the Deluxe Sea View room at ฿700, which has hot water and a private balcony.
pros: Cheapest in the guide, ฿400, at the end of White Sand Beach
Backpacker vibe with a relaxed seaside bar (per reviews)
Rooms on the rocks with sea views, a one-of-a-kind setting
Walkable to the lively White Sand Beach strip
cons: Cheap rooms are fan-only, some with a shared, cold-water bathroom
Very basic — none of the facilities of a resort

entries.name: Bang Bao Cliff View Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Bao · clifftop above the bay · Koh Chang
tags: 🌊 Sea views over Bang Bao bay
entries.storyHtml: Bang Bao Cliff View is a clifftop resort above Bang Bao bay at the southern tip of the island, scoring 7.0 from 195 reviews. Reviews most often mention the sea views from the bungalows looking down over the rocky Bang Bao bay, and the quiet away from the crowds. Rooms range from light-priced fan bungalows at ฿700 up to air-con sea-view rooms. The score is middling and the rooms are basic, but it suits budget travellers who want a sea view and a quiet setting near Bang Bao pier for boat trips to nearby islands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view and air-con, pick the Sea View Bungalow at ฿1,500. It's on a clifftop, so the swim spot isn't a sandy beach — you'll drive to other beaches.
pros: Sea views over Bang Bao bay from the bungalows (per reviews)
Quiet, away from the crowds, near Bang Bao pier for island boats
Light-priced fan rooms from ฿700 · air-con sea-view rooms too
Good for budget travellers who want a view and quiet
cons: Middling 7.0 score · basic rooms, few facilities
On a clifftop with no sandy beach out front — you'll drive to beaches

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are indicative starting rates and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking. Koh Chang room rates swing heavily by season: in high season (November–April) skies are clear and the sea is lovely but prices are high and rooms fill fast, while in the low rainy season (May–October) prices drop sharply and some properties close, so check before booking. Koh Chang has no city public transport — get around by rental vehicle or songthaew, and reach the island by a 30–45 minute car ferry from Laem Ngop pier in Trat. Scores and standout details come from reading real guest reviews, not from staying ourselves · Article by ThailandAddict
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Koh Chang hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which beach should I stay on in Koh Chang?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style · White Sand Beach suits those who want the liveliest spot with lots of restaurants and bars (KC Grande, Independent Bo's) · Klong Prao is a long, quieter beach good for families (Emerald Cove, Aana, Klong Prao Resort) · Kai Bae has a sandy beach with island views, lovely at sunset (Sylvan, Kaibae Beach Resort) · Lonely Beach / Bailan is the chilled-out quiet southern zone (Nest Sense, Warapura) · Bang Bao is a fishing-village pier at the tip for boat trips (Bang Bao Cliff View, Indie Beach) · Klong Son up north near the pier is quiet and private (Aiyapura)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Koh Chang hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: guesthouses and fan bungalows start around ฿400–1,500 a night · mid-range and boutique beachfront resorts up to 3-star run around ฿1,500–3,500 · luxury 4-star beachfront resorts start around ฿2,500–7,000+, with pool villas higher still · Koh Chang rates swing a lot by season — high season (November–April) is notably pricier than the rainy months.

faq.q: ❓ How far in advance should I book a Koh Chang hotel?
faq.a: For low season and weekdays, booking 2–4 weeks ahead is enough · but in high season (November–April), especially over New Year, Songkran and long weekends, the good rooms — particularly beachfront resorts and pool villas — fill up fast, so book 1–2 months ahead or more · in the rainy season some properties close, so check first.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Koh Chang hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ depending on the promotions running at the time, so it's worth opening all 3 and comparing before every booking — each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save several hundred to over a thousand baht a night on higher-priced rooms.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Koh Chang, and where's the ferry?
faq.a: Koh Chang is in Trat province — you cross by car ferry from Laem Ngop pier (Centerpoint or Ao Thammachat piers), a roughly 30–45 minute crossing · the ferries take both passengers and cars, so you can drive across · on the island there's no city public transport; get around by rental car, scooter, or the songthaew trucks that run the west-coast road.

faq.q: ❓ When is the best time to visit Koh Chang, and what's the weather like?
faq.a: The best weather is roughly November–April, with clear skies, a lovely sea and good swimming and snorkelling (this is high season, with higher prices and rooms filling fast) · May–October is the rainy season with frequent rain and choppier sea — accommodation is much cheaper, but some resorts and shops close, so check before booking.
